weakness: Vulnerability scanning (pip-audit (Python deps), Trivy (containers/IaC/deps), Checkov (IaC compliance), pnpm audit (JS deps)) runs on every push/PR, but not on a fixed schedule, so newly disclosed CVEs in unchanged dependencies are not caught until the next commit.
remediation: add a scheduled (cron) scan to satisfy 3.11.2[d] for newly identified vulnerabilities.
